title: Help shape VAI’s FAA reauthorization priorities
summary: The current FAA reauthorization expires on Sept. 30, 2028, with Congress expected to start considering new legislative proposals in early 2027.
body_markdown:
Congress periodically passes legislation known as Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) reauthorization to authorize FAA programs, establish aviation policy priorities, and make changes to federal aviation law.


The current FAA reauthorization expires on Sept. 30, 2028, with Congress expected to start considering new legislative proposals in early 2027.


VAI is preparing its core legislative priorities for the 2028 FAA reauthorization bill. The reauthorization process also allows VAI to address challenges or other issues facing the industry.


As such, VAI is seeking input from its members on operational challenges or ideas on how to improve the future of vertical aviation. VAI wants to hear from you!


From now through Dec. 31, 2026, VAI invites members to submit policy proposals they would like VAI to review using our[FAA Reauthorization Proposal Form](https://verticalavi.org/vai-member-faa-reauthorization-proposal-form/) .


Please note: Submission of a proposal does not guarantee that VAI will adopt, endorse, or advocate for a particular proposal.


Contactadvocacy@verticalavi.org with any questions.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Vertical Aviation International.*
